description: Prepares a vibe-* project for deployment to 7 platforms: Railway, Render, Fly.io, Heroku, Vercel, Netlify, GitHub Pages. Detects stack automatically (FastAPI, Express, Next.js, Django, React, Vue, static). Patches source files (port binding to $PORT, adds /health endpoint, production CORS). Generates platform config files scoped per service — backend, web, worker. Inlines non-secret env vars directly in config files per service. Links database connections using platform-native syntax. Generates ENV_SETUP.md with per-service CLI commands for secrets only. Handles background workers and cron services if the project requires them. Optionally generates GitHub Actions CI/CD workflow. Produces DEPLOY.md step-by-step checklist. Triggers: deploy: railway, deploy: render, deploy: fly, deploy: heroku, deploy: vercel, deploy: netlify, deploy: github-pages.
